protocol.context: healthy selected Context; unchanged initial weights and update function
protocol.prediction: Context -> frozen CNN; no prediction routing
protocol.objective: maximize mean(p*(gap/sd_gap + weighted_gain/sd_gain - weighted_harm/sd_harm - cost)) under early-window quota
protocol.interpretation: reweighted constrained local min-max surrogate; Context descent unchanged up to positive gap scaling; not the original multistep objective
protocol.deployment: TRAIN-logit rank; exact label cap by first 20 percent of the stream; fixed Actor online
protocol.collection: uniform TRAIN feedback; copied Context/Adam states; no query/router training
protocol.selection: VAL online AC minus positive source drop; no TEST targets or selection
protocol.experiment: TRAIN-scaled competitive signals with an early query window
protocol.signal_scaling: positive standard deviation scales from measured TRAIN only; no centering or TEST fitting

rank_warm_start.loss: within-TRAIN-level pairwise softplus preference; initialization only
rank_warm_start.validation: fixed observer-only VAL targets; no fitting; TRAIN scales/normalizer frozen
rank_warm_start.continuation: reset Adam; original signed quota-max objective only; select within max phase on online VAL

domain_quota.objective: equal mean of within-level mean(p*S), independent quota offset for each TRAIN level
domain_quota.minibatch: every TRAIN level; up to batch_size//3 rows per level without replacement
domain_quota.quota: each collection cap divided by its query-window row count
domain_quota.deployment: unchanged; level identities used only in TRAIN constraints and offline ranking audit
